# Psalm 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-shiggaion of-David, which he-sang to-YHWH concerning the-words of-Cush the-Benjaminite.

**2** YHWH my-God, in-You I-take-refuge; save-me from-all my-pursuers and-deliver-me,

**3** lest he-tear like-a-lion my-soul, rending and-there-is-no deliverer.

**4** YHWH my-God, if I-have-done this, if there-is injustice in-my-hands,

**5** if I-have-repaid my-ally [with] evil — and-I-stripped [even] my-adversary without-cause —

**6** let-the-enemy pursue my-soul and-overtake [it], and-let-him-trample to-the-ground my-life, and-my-honor in-the-dust let-him-lay. Selah.

**7** Arise, YHWH, in-Your-anger; lift-Yourself-up against-the-fury of-my-adversaries, and-awake for-me [the] judgment [You] have-commanded.

**8** And-the-assembly of-peoples surrounds-You; and-over-it to-the-height return.

**9** YHWH judges the-peoples; judge-me, YHWH, according-to-my-righteousness and-according-to-my-integrity upon-me.

**10** Let-the-evil of-the-wicked come-to-an-end, but-establish the-righteous, [O] tester of-hearts and-minds, O-righteous God.

**11** My-shield [is] upon God, the-One-saving the-upright of-heart.

**12** God [is] a-righteous judge, and-a-God who-has-indignation every day.

**13** If [a man] does-not repent, He-sharpens His-sword; His-bow He-bends and-makes-ready.

**14** And-for-him He-prepares instruments-of death; His-arrows He-makes into-flaming [ones].

**15** Behold, he-is-in-labor [with] iniquity and-conceives trouble and-gives-birth-to falsehood.

**16** A-pit he-digs and-hollows-it-out, and-he-falls into-the-hole he-made.

**17** His-trouble returns upon-his-head, and-upon his-crown his-violence descends.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **7:1**: Shiggaion — a term of uncertain meaning, possibly a passionate or emotional song. Related to the verb shagah, 'to wander/err.'

- **7:15-16**: The pregnancy metaphor for evil (conceive-bear-birth) followed by the pit metaphor — evil is both organic and self-destructive.

— EMET
